keys.beat: Odysseus and his allies pursue the suitors through the hall like falcons among smaller birds
The four come up the hall
Telemachus and Philoetius come at theirs
Leiodes clasps Odysseus's knees but is killed despite claiming innocence
Phemius and Medon appeal for mercy and Telemachus confirms their limited complicity
Odysseus spares the bard and herald and orders them into the courtyard
The bard and the herald go out
The living search the blood-filled hall for any remaining threat
